evidence.title: shotsnapp - Create beautiful device mockup presentation

name: shotsnapp
summary: Browser tool that turns app screenshots into device mockups on phones, tablets, laptops and smart watches.
description: Pick a device and a pre-designed template, drop in a screenshot or design file, adjust the background, fonts and Unsplash photos, then export the mockup as PNG or JPEG for portfolios, presentations and social posts. Basic use is free; PRO is a one-time 48 USD year.
contains: device mockups: mobile phones, tablets, laptops, smart watches
free plan: 1 object per canvas, free templates, PNG/JPEG export
PRO, 48 USD for 1 year: unlimited objects and templates, unlimited Unsplash photos, more device styles
